One of the better survivor games out there. The arsenal of weapons feels very varied (even though I hate the anchor). The characters have very unique and interesting traits. I think the biggest innovation here is the islands system with an "expanding" arena. Instead of having a "shop" every round, you have a few types of islands which you can upgrade and visit at any time. The art is great and polished, I like that you can change the color scheme of the game. The gameplay itself feels snappy and responsive. Overall, highly recommend if you like arena shooters like Brotato

It's a really fun game, but it's really frustrating when the game starts to chug due to too many coins on the screen or enemies. When I have [spoiler] all of the challenges on and the zapping gun [/spoiler] the game will start to stutter even with a 5900X and a 3080. This has basically killed any of these runs. I don't think that should be the case for a 2D game. Edit: If this affects you, go to task manager -> details -> Nautical Surival -> Right Click -> Set Priority -> Realtime / High. This helps a lot.
